parameters.description_en: The set of permissions to be granted to the role. The value is in the format of `Permission group ID 1:Permission serial number 1;...;Permission group ID n:Permission serial number n`. Example: `1:1;1:2;2:1;2:2`. For more information about permission groups and permission serial numbers, see [ListAuthority](~~149409~~).
